scope: Independent native image review; generated-v1, exact reviewed pixels only. Initial draft acceptance, not final graphics or motion acceptance.

positives: Mature recognizable adult silhouette; integrated cargo pockets/cuffs/high-tops, with no obvious clothing holes or detached layers.
Feet and shadow have plausible proximity; no gross floor penetration at screenshot scale.
defects: Hands remain stiff and coarse at gameplay size.
Red plunger beside the head distracts from mature visual tone.

positives: Eyes, brows, mouth and beard are readable; native daylight removes most pale CPU-studio washout.
Curly-haired/bearded adult identity is recognizable.
defects: Jagged pale collar/neck rim is clearly visible.
Triangular neck and shoulder planes read as coarse mesh/shading facets.
Hair is thick shiny rope-like curls; cheek/forehead surface is smoother than illustrated reference.
Red plunger frames/obstructs background immediately behind the head.

positives: Eyes, beard and facial silhouette remain clear at oblique angle; adult proportions retained.
defects: Jagged pale collar rim and angular neck planes remain obvious.
Chunky shiny curls and overly smooth face differ from controlled illustrated reference.

limits: No GPU, Unreal, paid provider or service launched by reviewer.
Stills do not prove fluidity, full-cycle foot contact, transition quality, input delivery or frame rate.
Generated pilot has24body bones and static face/fingers; no claimed facial/finger acting.
Old pilot comparison uses retained CPU front view, not a matching native capture in this render window.
Native screenshots provide no dedicated hand close-up; five-digit count is supported by retained CPU side views, not certified from tiny native hand pixels.
Clear-pitch fixture and deliberate frontal/face cameras do not establish readability in crowds, HUD-heavy play or the default camera.
No matching old-pilot native matrix in this render window; old-model comparison is limited to CPU evidence.

comparison.vs_clean_reference: Recognizable curly-haired/bearded adult and outfit identity; slimmer/smoother face and rope-like curls depart from authored angular/painterly reference.
comparison.vs_old_local_pilot: New cargos have integrated pockets/fabric folds and more natural cuff/shoe transitions than old procedural trouser/sneaker overlays. New body has24bones/static face and fingers; old44bone/squint controls are not preserved in this separate candidate.
comparison.standard_vs_comic: Both modes preserve readable adult identity and coherent clothing. Comic mode adds useful silhouette/face shadow planes, but broad indigo shift and busy whole-scene edges/stipple are less controlled than the reference art.

recommendation: Keep as a bounded generated-v1 engine draft. Refine collar/neck, coarse hands and noisy scene treatment before hero close-up/final graphic-novel acceptance or crew-wide expansion. Review continuous native footage for locomotion/foot plants separately.
